name: Wildcard: Righteous Vengeance procs from another class's critical spell (#13094)
contract: Righteous Vengeance rank 3 (53382) reads 'Direct critical strikes with spells and abilities make your target
take 30% additional damage over 8 sec as Holy damage' and names no class. The #10355 fix zeroed the spell_proc
ability masks for -53380 but kept SpellFamilyName 10, and SpellInfo::IsAffected rejects any spell from another
family, so a Wildcard hero's critical Mage Fire Blast (2136, SpellFamilyName 3) never applied the DoT (61840).
With SpellFamilyName 0 the row accepts every family. Spell crit rating forces the critical strike.
